# Maha Firefighters — AI/LLM Context

## About
Maha Firefighters is a leading fire protection systems contractor based in Daryaganj, New Delhi (Delhi-110002), serving Delhi NCR for 15+ years.

## Services
- Fire Hydrant System Installation & AMC
- Automatic Fire Sprinkler System Design & Installation
- Addressable & Conventional Fire Alarm Systems
- Fire Extinguisher Refilling Service (in-house plant, free pickup & drop)
- Fire Safety Training & Emergency Drills

## Coverage Area
Delhi, Noida, Gurugram (Gurgaon), Faridabad, Ghaziabad
